license_evidence.scope: Model weights, parameters, configuration files, inference code, and associated documentation in the Qwen/Qwen3-14B repository

access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen/Qwen3-14B weight release of the April 2025 Qwen3 series, a hybrid model that switches between thinking and non-thinking modes, at Hugging Face commit 40c069824f4251a91eefaf281ebe4c544efd3e18 (last modified 2025-07-26), together with the hosted qwen3-14b API model. The Base checkpoint, the other Qwen3 sizes, later Qwen generations, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated dense checkpoint carrying the verbatim Apache-2.0 license file beside the weights
First-party Model Studio documentation names the exact qwen3-14b model ID as a served model
tradeoffs: Native context is 32K tokens and the 131K length needs a YaRN rope-scaling setting that the card says can affect shorter inputs
Version identity rests on repository commits with no stated retirement posture
